text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Wow, you made it look super easy! ♪ Thanks a lot, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, I just know my Umadol skills will soar with this Cutie in my room! And then…

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: The two of us will walk the road to top Umadol together!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: That means I'm counting on you from now on! Let's kick things off with a duet! ☆
